project_type: Tauri v2 desktop app: Rust core crates (hybrid-orchestrator/crates/*) + React 18 / TypeScript webview (hybrid-orchestrator/frontend, Vite + zustand + vitest)
build_system: Cargo with an EMPTY [workspace] members array; every crate is [workspace] exclude'd and built per-crate via `--manifest-path crates/<crate>/Cargo.toml`. Frontend uses npm + vite + tsc. Never run `cargo fmt --all` / `cargo *--workspace`; there are no members so they act on nothing.
test_framework: Rust: cargo test per-crate with in-crate #[cfg(test)] modules; providers tests use wiremock MockServer; secrets/tauri tests use InMemorySecretStore. Frontend: vitest + @testing-library/react with a hand-rolled `invoke` mock (vi.mock('@tauri-apps/api/core')).
build_command: Per-crate: `cargo build --manifest-path hybrid-orchestrator/crates/<crate>/Cargo.toml`. Frontend: `cd hybrid-orchestrator/frontend && npm run build` (tsc && vite build).
test_command: Per-crate: `cargo test --manifest-path hybrid-orchestrator/crates/<crate>/Cargo.toml`. Frontend: `cd hybrid-orchestrator/frontend && npm test` (vitest run).
verification_instructions: OFFLINE SANDBOX CANNOT run cargo build/clippy/test (crates.io 403), npm install (npm 403), tauri build, or hit live endpoints. Correctness rests on: (1) code tracing, (2) tests that are structurally correct, (3) offline `cargo fmt --check` per changed crate and `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` in frontend if a prettier binary is already present, (4) manual review that every changed serde boundary type has its TS mirror + every affected vitest mock updated. GitHub Actions CI is the authoritative build/test/clippy gate.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. There is NO codegen between Rust and TS: frontend/src/types/index.ts is a hand-maintained mirror of the Rust serde DTOs and MUST be updated in the same change when a boundary type changes.
setup_instructions: No install possible offline. On CI: dtolnay/rust-toolchain stable + clippy + rustfmt; ubuntu installs Tauri v2 system deps; node 22 + `npm install` in frontend.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network: no crates.io, no npm registry, no live Ollama/Gemini/OpenAI/Kiro endpoints, no Docker. All build/test/lint verification is deferred to CI. Do NOT attempt cargo build or npm install; they will fail on 403. The user's own v0.7.3 desktop build is the behavioral proof source.
contribution_requirements: clippy is run with -D warnings on CI: no unused imports, no unused Result (removing a `let _ =` that discarded a Result means the Result must now be consumed), no needless_lifetimes. Doc comments are flat prose. TS: eslint no-unused-vars, tsc strict. serde uses #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")] on every boundary type. Any new/changed #[tauri::command] must be added to generate_handler! in crates/tauri-app/src/lib.rs AND get an ipc/commands.ts wrapper AND a TS type. Format per-crate (cargo fmt --manifest-path ...), never cargo fmt --all.
key_patterns: SHARED-ENUMERATION-AS-SINGLE-SOURCE: providers::list_available_models (crates/providers/src/builtins.rs) is the ONE enumeration both the picker (list_available_models_inner) and diagnostics (provider_diagnostics_inner) consume, so they cannot drift. It records a per-provider ProviderEnumerationError { provider_id, message } for two clean-empty causes: (a) a config row with NO built instance (registry.get returns None) currently gets a STATIC generic message 'provider is configured but no instance was built...'; (b) a built instance whose list_models() errors gets the real ProviderError Display. THE BUG: both commands.rs callers build each row with `let _ = registry.build_from_config(cfg, secret_store);` at commands.rs ~line 524 and ~line 671, DISCARDING the Err(ProviderError) that carries the REAL build-failure cause (bad key ref, missing base_url, auth resolve failure). So case (a) always shows the generic message. ProviderError (crates/providers/src/contract.rs ~line 293) is a thiserror enum (Transport/HttpStatus/Decode/UnsupportedCapability/Auth/Other) whose Display is display-safe (Auth carries a REASON string from secret resolution, not the key material - VERIFY this stays true). SECRET HYGIENE: SecretStore::resolve is the only plaintext seam; no command return type or error may carry key material. Cloud kinds map to stable per-kind ids via cloud_provider_config_id (gemini-cloud, generic-openai-cloud, etc.); local runtimes via local_runtime_config_id (generic-openai-local, lmstudio-local). base_url validation lives in validate_base_url/check_provider_base_url in commands.rs and is ADVISORY (warns on plaintext, blocks only link-local/metadata IPs).
relevant_files: hybrid-orchestrator/crates/providers/src/builtins.rs (shared list_available_models + ProviderEnumerationError + AvailableModelsResult; the generic 'no instance was built' message lives here ~line 280)
hybrid-orchestrator/crates/providers/src/contract.rs (ProviderError enum ~line 293; verify Auth Display carries reason not key)

hybrid-orchestrator/crates/providers/src/adapters/gemini.rs (build_gemini + GeminiFactory; requires api_key_ref, defaults base_url to https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com, list_models GET /v1beta/models)

directory_structure: hybrid-orchestrator/crates/{domain,secrets,persistence,orchestrator-core,providers,routing,mcp-client,tauri-app,engine}; providers/src/adapters/* holds one file per provider kind; tauri-app/src/commands.rs is the single IPC command file (~4700 lines) with #[cfg(test)] tests inline. frontend/src/features/settings/* holds the Settings sections; frontend/src/types/index.ts is the hand-mirror; frontend/src/ipc/commands.ts the invoke wrappers.
